anchor: Inclusive recognition of para-sports and disability representation
argumentsAgainst: A ceremonial congratulation alone does not establish sustained institutional support, accessibility, coaching quality, or post-career rehabilitation.

argumentsFor: Public recognition by the Prime Minister’s Office can improve visibility of para-sports and challenge stereotypes about persons with disabilities.
Recognition may encourage social respect and strengthen the symbolic link between sporting achievement and inclusion.

example.text: Hypothetically, if a public institution recognises a para-athlete while sports facilities remain inaccessible, the recognition may improve visibility but cannot by itself ensure wider participation.
